title: 英文第4題｜錢包在哪裡被偷
subject: English
question: Ronald 不確定他的錢包是在哪裡被偷的。
answer: Ronald is not sure where his wallet was stolen.
explanation:
is not sure 描述 Ronald 現在不確定。where 引出他不確定的地方，其後用 his wallet＋was stolen 的直述語序。

錢包先前遭竊，用單數過去被動 was stolen。steal 的三態是 steal、stole、stolen。過去分詞放在 was 之後。
studentAnswer: Ronald is not sure where his wallet is stoled. 紅筆改 was stolen。
